fine_lines.title: this / that / these / those
fine_lines.explanation_ar: this (هذا/هذه) للمفرد القريب، that (ذلك/تلك) للمفرد البعيد، these (هؤلاء/هذه) للجمع القريب، those (أولئك/تلك) للجمع البعيد.
fine_lines.explanation_en: This = one thing near. That = one thing far. These = many things near. Those = many things far.

fine_lines.title: put on vs wear vs take off
fine_lines.explanation_ar: put on = حركة لبس الملابس، wear = أن تكون الملابس عليك، take off = خلع الملابس.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Put on = the action of dressing. Wear = to have it on your body. Take off = to remove it.

examples.sentence: I wear a jacket every day in winter.

fine_lines.title: casual vs formal
fine_lines.explanation_ar: casual ملابس مريحة للأيام العادية (جينز وتي شيرت). formal ملابس رسمية للمناسبات والعمل (بدلة وربطة عنق).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Casual clothes are relaxed, for normal days (jeans, t-shirt). Formal clothes are for special events or work (suit, tie).

examples.sentence: Jeans and a t-shirt are too casual.
A suit and a tie are formal.

expressions.phrase: How about jeans and a t-shirt?

expressions.example: I can't wear it. It's not the right size.

expressions.meaning_en: It is smaller than I need.
expressions.example: My old jacket is too small now.

expressions.meaning_en: The color green is good for you.
Let's do it one more time.
expressions.example: That doesn't work. Let's try again.

expressions.meaning_en: These things don't look good together.
expressions.example: Red shoes with that dress? That does not match.

expressions.meaning_en: Yes, sure; there is no reason not to.
expressions.example: "Can you put on a hat?" "Why not?"

expressions.meaning_en: It is good now; it was not so good before.
expressions.example: Take off the hat. That's better.
Those clothes are for a man. Something is wrong.

expressions.meaning_en: look as good as I can
expressions.example: I want to look my best for the theater.

grammar.title: Demonstratives: this, that, these, those
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) this و that مع اسم مفرد: this shirt, that hat.
٢) these و those مع اسم جمع: these clothes, those shoes.
٣) القريب: this/these، البعيد: that/those.
٤) الفعل يتبع العدد: This dress is... / These clothes are...
grammar.explanation_en:
1) This and that go with singular nouns: this shirt, that hat.
2) These and those go with plural nouns: these clothes, those shoes.
3) Near: this/these. Far: that/those.
4) The verb agrees: This dress is... / These clothes are...
examples: Those clothes look great on you.

grammar.title: too + adjective
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) too + صفة تعني أكثر من اللازم، أي توجد مشكلة.
٢) It's too small = لا يناسبني لأنه صغير.
٣) لا تخلط بين too و very: very small = صغير جدًا (وقد يكون جيدًا)، too small = صغير بشكل غير مناسب.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) too + adjective = more than is good; there is a problem.
2) It's too small = it doesn't fit.
3) very small just means very small; too small means it is a problem.
examples: Jeans are too casual for the theater.

grammar.title: Making suggestions: How about ...? / Let's ...
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) How about + اسم أو فعل مع ing: How about a hat? / How about going out?
٢) Let's + فعل أساسي: Let's try a green shirt.
٣) الرد: Sure! / Why not? / Good idea!
grammar.explanation_en:
1) How about + noun or verb-ing: How about a hat? / How about going out?
2) Let's + base verb: Let's try a green shirt.
3) Answers: Sure! / Why not? / Good idea!
examples: How about wearing the blue jacket?
